definitions.explanation: Tomato ketchup, the condiment. Used the same way as in English.

⟦フライドポテト→フライドポテト：29026_furaidopoteto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ケチャップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。

notes:
From English "ketchup." Refers to tomato ketchup, the most common condiment variety in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ケチャップ⟦ライス→ライス：08838_raisu⟧: ketchup-flavored fried rice
- ケチャップ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: ketchup flavor
- トマトケチャップ: tomato ketchup (the full formal name)
- ケチャップ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put ketchup on

ASSOCIATED DISHES:
Ketchup is a key ingredient in several iconic Japanese-Western (⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧) dishes:
- オムライス: omurice (ketchup rice wrapped in omelet)
- ⟦ナポリタン→ナポリタン：30400_naporitan⟧: Napolitan spaghetti (ketchup-based pasta)
- ケチャップ⟦ライス→ライス：08838_raisu⟧: ketchup fried rice

These dishes are staples of ⟦{洋食|ようしょく}→洋食：13274_youshoku⟧ (Western-style Japanese cuisine) and are very popular comfort food.
